image_description: A close-up studio shot of an intricate, chunky beaded necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features large, textured blue beads with metallic filigree or mesh overlays, interspersed with smaller amber and green glass beads. A prominent oval amber bead with a starburst pattern serves as a central focal point. The construction involves wire-wrapping and metal findings connecting the various components.

artifact_observations.location: Blue textured beads on the left side
artifact_observations.reasoning: The mesh/filigree texture on the large blue beads appears slightly soft and repetitive, lacking the crisp micro-detail of real metal mesh, suggesting potential AI smoothing or generation artifacts.
Some wire loops appear to merge into the beads without a clear entry/exit point, or terminate abruptly in mid-air (e.g., top right cluster), violating physical connectivity rules of jewelry making.
The starburst pattern inside the amber bead seems slightly warped and does not follow the curvature of the bead surface realistically, appearing somewhat flat or pasted on.

focus_areas: Connectivity of wire loops to beads (physical plausibility)
Reflection consistency on glass vs. metal surfaces
Texture detail on the filigree/mesh beads
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the wire-wrapping logic. AI often fails to render continuous wires that actually pass through bead holes or wrap around them securely. Look for wires that start or end in empty space. Also, scrutinize the reflections on the amber bead; AI often generates generic shiny spots rather than environment-mapped reflections.
